cells.scene: An adult holds an old childhood toy tenderly and smiles with moist eyes, memories shown by a small faded childhood vignette.
A host generously fills a long dining table with abundant varied dishes and flowers for a small group of guests.
A perfectly clean white kitchen has polished surfaces, neatly arranged cups and no stains, crumbs or clutter.
A close view of polished parquet flooring made from interlocking rectangular wood blocks in a herringbone pattern, clear wood grain.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — sentimentally (ad.感情上，多情地): An adult holds an old childhood toy tenderly and smiles with moist eyes, memories shown by a small faded childhood vignette.
TOP RIGHT — lavishly (ad.慷慨地，大方地): A host generously fills a long dining table with abundant varied dishes and flowers for a small group of guests.
BOTTOM LEFT — immaculate (a.清洁的，无污点的): A perfectly clean white kitchen has polished surfaces, neatly arranged cups and no stains, crumbs or clutter.
BOTTOM RIGHT — parquet (n.镶木地板): A close view of polished parquet flooring made from interlocking rectangular wood blocks in a herringbone pattern, clear wood grain.
CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: sentimental childhood toy, lavish abundant meal, spotless kitchen, and true interlocking wood parquet pattern. No text or quadrant overlap.
